content.value: The output of a biopotential preamplifier that measures the EOG is an undesired dc voltage (10) of ±5V due to electrode half-cell potentials, with a desired signal of ±1V superimposed. Design a circuit that will balance the DC voltage to zero and provide a gain of -10 for the desired signal without saturating the Op-amp.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
